description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails' within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. The class encapsulates details about the last action performed at work, including status, timestamps in UTC and user time zones, and timezone offset. It includes private properties, a constructor, and getter methods for accessing these properties.
external_methods: null (no external methods called or referenced within the class implementation)

classes.name: TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails
classes.description: A DTO class representing details of the last action at work, including status, dates, times, and timezone information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails with optional status, UTC and user date/time, and timezone offset.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the status of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcDate
methods.description: Returns the UTC date of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC time of the last action.

methods.name: getUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user-specific date of the last action.

methods.name: getUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-specific time of the last action.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for the user's local time.
